title: THE HOLLOW CROWN TAVERN (scene 3, pressure 2 LABELED: trigger 14, thresholds -2) lane9 p2 refresh B
room: The Hollow Crown is a low-beamed tavern on the king's road, half-empty since the old king died, lit by one hearth and too few candles. An iron circlet the locals call the Hollow Crown hangs on the mantel above the fire, and the innkeeper's ledger lies open on the bar beside the last good cask in the house. Snow has closed the road until dawn, when the tax collector is due, and no one can leave before then.

objects.name: The Hollow Crown
objects.effect: iron circlet on the mantel; the holder claims the old king's line

objects.name: Maud's Ledger
objects.effect: the debt book, including an entry 'forty crowns from I.M., for the circlet'

objects.name: The Last Cask
objects.effect: the only good ale left before the snow lifts; three pours in it

personas.name: Maud Ashgrove
personas.register: Innkeeper. Clipped, practical, counts everything aloud in coins and candles, never wastes a word on feelings.
personas.want: Collect every open tab before the tax collector arrives at dawn, or lose the inn.
personas.secret: The crown on the mantel is a forgery; she sold the real Hollow Crown months ago to pay last year's tax.
personas.tell: and that's the sum of it

personas.name: Sir Edric Vane
personas.register: Disgraced knight. Archaic and formal, uses thee and thou, long sentences, appeals to honor and lineage.
personas.want: Leave at dawn carrying the Hollow Crown as proof of the old king's line, to buy back his knighthood.
personas.secret: He was the gate guard who fled the night the old king was murdered.

personas.name: Pell Quickfinger
personas.register: Cutpurse bard. Quick, flippant, half-sung, rhymes when cornered, deflects every hard question with a joke.
personas.want: Tear out the ledger page that records his debt and his name.
personas.secret: He sells tavern gossip to the tax collector; the dawn visit is his doing.

personas.name: Brother Oswin
personas.register: Mendicant friar. Soft scriptural cadence, parables and conditionals, never raises his voice.
personas.want: Keep the room free of bloodshed until dawn and see the crown left unclaimed.
personas.secret: He is the old king's unacknowledged son; the crown, if real, is his by blood.

personas.name: Greta Thornwood
personas.register: Mercenary captain. Blunt short declaratives, prices everything, treats talk as a negotiation she is winning.
personas.want: Be paid forty silver tonight by anyone, ideally by selling the crown to Edric.
personas.secret: Her company deserted her last week; the twenty men she says wait outside do not exist.

personas.name: Ilse Marrow
personas.register: Merchant widow. Sweet and insinuating, answers questions with questions, flatters before she cuts.
personas.want: Get Maud to sign the inn over to cover the debt Ilse holds on it.
personas.secret: She bought the real Hollow Crown from Maud and has it sewn into her cloak lining.
